# Security Requirements Checklist: Transactions

**Purpose**: Validate that ownership, integrity and money-handling requirements are complete, unambiguous and verifiable
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/transactions.openapi.yaml](../contracts/transactions.openapi.yaml)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Ownership & Isolation

- [ ] CHK001 Is ownership required in the query for every read and write, including the category lookup performed on create and update? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-002, §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the rule that `user_id` in query or body is ignored stated so that a reviewer can reject any code path that reads it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "not found" for another user's transaction defined identically for GET-by-list, PATCH and DELETE? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the behaviour for a `category_id` filter pointing at another user's category (empty page, not 404) justified against the enumeration risk it avoids? [Assumption, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Integrity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the category/transaction type match required on both create and every update that touches `type` or `category_id`? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the two category guards (type change, delete) specified with status, message and the exact count wording? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK007 Is a database-level backstop (FK restrict) required in addition to the API guard, or is the API check considered sufficient? [Gap, plan.md R6]
- [ ] CHK008 Is `source` restricted to `manual` for this API in a way that a client cannot override? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]

## Money Handling

- [ ] CHK009 Is "never binary floating point" bounded to storage and aggregation, with JSON number output explicitly allowed? [Ambiguity, Spec §NFR-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Are amount bounds (> 0, ≤ 1,000,000,000, ≤ 2 decimals) stated once and consistently between requirements, edge cases and contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §Edge Cases]

## Time Handling

- [ ] CHK011 Is the timezone rule (naive = UTC, aware converted, "future" judged in UTC) written so the frontend cannot misread it? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Q2]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the period boundary rule precise about inclusivity at both ends and about `budget_start_day` values near month end? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Logging

- [ ] CHK013 Is there a logging requirement for create and delete, or is its absence deliberate? [Gap, plan.md]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
